notes: Mask or remove nectar guides and quantify Bombus/small-bee visitation and seed/siring consequences; most direct falsification of S1 independent of selfing.
Measure natural guide variation and visitation/siring success while controlling flower size and selfing status; separates direct selection from selfing-mediated degeneration.
Bagging and hand self/cross treatments to quantify autonomous selfing and reproductive assurance; key for S2 vs pollinator-substitution-only explanations.
Estimate multilocus outcrossing rate t_m per population; validates selfing gradient independently of flower morphology.
Compare guide/flower-size Qst against neutral Fst; Qst greater than Fst suggests selection beyond drift-only null.
Independent neutral He/Fis/Fst estimates to calibrate drift/background isolation and avoid using selfing-generated Fis proxies.
Exclude or stratify small halictid-like visitors to test whether small-pollinator substitution explains reduced flower size/guide independent of Bombus loss.
Standardized current visitor census; can update x_obs or become y_obs if the question targets contemporary pollinator shifts.
